definitions.explanation: A position that is both forward and to the side. Used for giving directions and describing spatial relationships.

examples.japanese: ⟦{銀行|ぎんこう}→銀行：00578_ginkou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{斜|なな}め{前|まえ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦あります→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: The bank is diagonally in front.
Who is the person sitting diagonally in front?

examples.japanese: ⟦コンビニ→コンビニ：01081_konbini⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|で}て→出る：00513_deru⟧⟦{右|みぎ}→右：02257_migi⟧{斜|なな}め{前|まえ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{白|しろ}い→白い：00587_shiroi⟧⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧です。
examples.english: The convenience store is the white building diagonally to the right in front after exiting the station.

notes:
A useful spatial term combining ⟦{斜|なな}め→斜め：00303_naname⟧ (diagonal; oblique) and ⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧ (front). Essential for giving and understanding directions in Japanese.

RELATED DIRECTIONAL TERMS:
- {斜|なな}め{後|うし}ろ: diagonally behind
- {斜|なな}め{右|みぎ}: diagonally to the right
- ⟦{斜|なな}め→斜め：00303_naname⟧⟦{左|ひだり}→左：00628_hidari⟧: diagonally to the left
- {真|ま}⟦{正面|しょうめん}→正面：13189_shoumen⟧: directly in front
- ⟦{真|ま}{向|む}かい→真向かい：16718_mamukai⟧: directly opposite

USAGE:
Very commonly used when giving directions, especially to describe the location of buildings relative to each other. Can be combined with ⟦{右|みぎ}→右：02257_migi⟧ or ⟦{左|ひだり}→左：00628_hidari⟧ for more precision: ⟦{右|みぎ}→右：02257_migi⟧{斜|なな}め{前|まえ} (diagonally front-right).
